_meta.name: Darivo reference dataset — real elite developers and flagship projects (UAE + Egypt)
_meta.purpose: Real, publicly reported project-level data for design review, demo realism and the map/home experience. NOT unit inventory and NOT an offer.
rules_for_use: Show every figure with its 'as_of' date and a 'Source' link in the UI.
Label all prices 'Indicative, publicly reported — confirm with advisor'.
Prices marked basis='listing' come from individual portal listings, not developer price lists; display them as 'Recently listed from', never as the developer's price.
Do not hotlink or copy developer renders, photos or logos. Use Darivo's own placeholder art and a text wordmark; link out to the official source.
Coordinates are approximate community-level centroids for map placement only; flag 'approx' and refine before production.
Unit-level availability for real projects is 'On request via your Darivo advisor'. Unit-level demo inventory must belong to fictional demo projects, clearly badged 'Demo'.
Re-verify every record before any public launch; prices and launches change frequently.
